title: Cloud error dialog shows the route's own reason, not the fixed 'provider could not complete' copy
description: Follow-up to MPI-979 (Fabio, 2026-09-29). cloudExecutor.cloudErrorMessage maps PROVIDER_ERROR to one fixed sentence and drops the route's message, so a reference the app itself could not read ('The reference image could not be read.', nothing sent, nothing billed) was shown as the provider's failure.
